name: OCBC 90°N Visa Card

Earn up to 7 Miles (equivalent to 7% cash rebate) for every S$1 spent on Agoda

Earn 2.1 Miles (equivalent to 2.1% cash rebate) for every S$1 spent in foreign currency
Earn unlimited miles that never expire

extra.summary: The OCBC 90°N Visa Card suits frequent travellers wanting flexible miles. Earn miles quickly on everyday spending with no monthly cap, especially for online shopping and food delivery. Benefit from a high earn rate on overseas spending. Miles offer flexibility, converting to airline and hotel loyalty programs.

minimum-income-requirements.Singaporean/PR Minimum Annual Income:
•At least S$30,000 for Singaporeans and Singapore PRs aged between 21 and 54
•At least S$15,000 for Singaporeans and Singapore PRs aged 55 and above

our_takes.our-take: The OCBC 90°N Visa Card suits frequent travellers wanting flexible miles. Earn miles quickly on everyday spending with no monthly cap, especially for online shopping and food delivery. Benefit from a high earn rate on overseas spending. Miles offer flexibility, converting to airline and hotel loyalty programs. A potential drawback is the S$5 transaction block, which might not suit smaller purchases. The first-year fee waiver and renewal bonus of 10,000 miles soften the S$196.20 annual fee from the second year.
our_takes.good-for:
Ideal for travel enthusiasts who want to earn miles on overseas spending with no miles expiry.
Good for individuals who frequently spend on streaming, online food delivery, and online shopping.
Great for Singaporeans and PRs earning S$30,000 or more looking for travel perks and rewards.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Annual fee of S$196.20 applies from the second year; evaluate if rewards outweigh this cost.
Late payment fee of S$100 applies if minimum payment isn't received by the due date.
A 3.25% foreign currency transaction fee applies, increasing the cost of overseas spending.
